# Corpus slice: 382 unique CTS-authored WGSL shaders (cases/ + manifest.tsv),
# extracted from the webgpu:shader,validation suite of gpuweb/cts @ 2959e1c
# (BSD-3-Clause) by the headless framework driver (tools/webgpu_cts_dump.mjs):
# 47,515 enumerated cases -> 22,034 ran clean -> 22,293 expectCompile{Result,Warning}
# captures -> unique expected=true entry-point shaders: 2,047 -> bounded slice
# (sha1 order, 5 per spec file, 91 spec files). From the full dump: 17,317
# expected=false (invalid-by-design WGSL; can never enter the round trip) and
# 2,862 no-entry-point module-scope cases are excluded and counted here, not
# silently dropped. 24,318 subcase-iterating cases were skipped by the dumper
# and 1,163 cases errored against the fake device (dump stats land next to the
# dump when regenerating); both are dumper scope, not corpus curation.
#
# Environment of this measurement: zioshade 0.6.0 (fix/wgsl-cts-undeclared-ids,
# on top of 467f8062), naga 30.0.0, macOS. naga is BOTH the WGSL -> SPIR-V
# upstream converter and the output validator.
#
# 2026-08-16 first measurement:
#   roundtrip-valid          259  (67.8% of 382; 83.8% of the 309 cases that
#                                  survived the upstream naga leg)
#   upstream-convert-failed   67  (naga front end refuses: 50x subgroups
#                                  enable, 5x @diagnostic, 5x const-expr
#                                  determinant, 4x atomic_vec2u_min_max, ...;
#                                  not zioshade's)
#   zioshade-refused          17  (honest errors incl. UnsupportedOp opcode
#                                  228 atomics, texture type variants)
#   zioshade-invalid          39  (exit 0, naga rejects the output)
#   CRASH                      0
#
# 2026-08-16 after fix/wgsl-cts-undeclared-ids:
#   roundtrip-valid          302  (79.1% of 382; 97.7% of the 309 cases that
#                                  survived the upstream naga leg)
#   upstream-convert-failed   67  (unchanged)
#   zioshade-refused          13  (4 former refusals were raised from DEAD
#                                  helpers that entry-point pruning removes)
#   zioshade-invalid           0  (all 39 fixed; see the delta note below)
#   CRASH                      0
#
# The zioshade-invalid class is the silent-wrong signal. Confirmed example:
# cts_2673680e1f3b (a 3-statement dead-store fragment shader) emits
# `var v8: vec3f = v5;` where v5 (the unnamed constant feeding an OpVariable
# initializer) is never declared: undeclared identifier at exit 0. Spread:
# texture_type, f16 vec4h, function_variables, stage/placement parsing; see
# per_case.tsv. These are report-only findings (breadth on an unfamiliar
# corpus), follow-up beads, NOT gate failures.
#
# ratchet: this file is a point-in-time credibility record. Refresh it (and the
# date) when the corpus or the backend changes; the sweep itself is non-gating
# and always exits 0 unless the HARNESS breaks (missing naga/CLI, empty or
# inconsistent corpus, classifier losing cases).
